name: Last Light: One More Shift
desc: Everybody went home. The building didn't. You are the last janitor in a building that changes after dark: close the boiler valves, leave Gary his forgotten lunch, water the rooftop plants — and find your way home. Gold machinery works by day, blue shadow bridges exist at night, and the Shift key flips the building between its two rhythms. A small puzzle platformer with touch controls, local progress, forgiving checkpoints, coyote time and jump buffering. English and Chinese story text with an in-game language toggle (defaults to English). No runtime dependencies, no network requests.
controls: A/D or arrows move, Space/W/Up jump (release for a shorter jump), Shift flips the day/night shift, click or tap to interact; in-game language toggle (EN/中文)
